title: chore(deps)(deps-dev): bump the development-dependencies group with 2 updates
body:
Bumps the development-dependencies group with 2 updates: [@types/node](https://github.com/DefinitelyTyped/DefinitelyTyped/tree/HEAD/types/node) and [autoprefixer](https://github.com/postcss/autoprefixer). Updates `@types/node` from 25.1.0 to 25.2.0
